item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is watching the night sky from the terrace of her home in Jaipur with her grandfather. She notices that the Sun looks large and very bright during the day, while all other stars look like tiny points of light and cannot be seen in the daytime sky.
Which statement explains this correctly?

options.A: The Sun is the largest star in the universe, so it looks bigger than all other stars from Earth.
options.B: Stars stop giving out light when the Sun rises, so they cannot be seen during the day.
options.C: The Sun is the star closest to Earth, so it appears large and bright; other stars are extremely far away, so they appear as tiny points, and their faint light is hidden by the Sun's glare during the day.
options.D: The Sun only looks bigger because it moves faster across the sky than the other stars.
